events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its first broadcast.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago, MTV changed music forever. Did video really kill the radio star, or did it just give it a new dimension?

events.title: Oasis' Debut Album Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album, 'Definitely Maybe', in 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. Still sounds as monumental today as it did back in '94. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, starting on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music at Woodstock. A truly legendary event.

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering The King, Elvis Presley, who we lost on this day in 1977. His legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to resonate decades later.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover alone is legendary, let alone the tracks within.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll energy.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that still resonates today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: iPod's Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music players, in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you fit in your pocket?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Favourites
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your ultimate 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The music world remembers John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible life and enduring legacy of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! What's your favourite Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. So much incredible music packed into one double LP.
